rdfs:label: Account
rdfs:comment: A Solid pod account — the user account on a Solid server, distinct from the WebID it issues.
notes: Solid-specific account class — represents the user record held by a Solid server (login credentials, owned pod, billing). Distinct from `urn:solid:OnlineAccount` (the FOAF generic account-on-a-service class) and from `urn:solid:account` (the FOAF property pointing at any online account). One Solid `Account` typically owns one pod and issues one WebID.

examples.title: Pod account on a Solid server

history.note: Initial term — Class form completing the Account/account case-pair, mapped to solid:Account (distinct from foaf:OnlineAccount, already covered by urn:solid:OnlineAccount).
